name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.5: the dashboard and Alerts tab now show real alerts. They were rendering DB.alerts, which was seeded from bundled demo data and localStorage and never hydrated from the backend, so genuine alerts such as cooling faults appeared nowhere except the machine-detail panel. A hydrate step now loads GET /alerts before rendering the dashboard and the Alerts tab, and resolving an alert posts to the resolve endpoint instead of only flipping a local flag (which reappeared on the next load). The alerts endpoint is also now scoped to the machines a user may access, with system alerts limited to ag_admin. Cumulative over v6.4.
